deities.name: The Quiet Oar
deities.description: The older principle of the crossing, revered by ferrymen and bellwrights who believe death was meant to grant peace rather than eternal labor.

deities.name: The Brass Scale
deities.description: The civic idol of the Chancery of Scales: cold equilibrium, recorded obligation, and survival purchased through strict hierarchy.

deities.name: The Pale Lantern
deities.description: Honored by frontier wardens and glass scholars who keep memory intact against the erasing salt-winds of the Reach.

deities.name: The Cinder Maw
deities.description: Whispered to by desperate alchemists and furnace barons who trade conscience and vitality for raw transmutative power.
